worldcombat.skill.geomancy.summary: Plant into the earth and draw on its ley energy: a ground rune lights up underfoot and the user stands rooted, gathering power; on the next beat the rune erupts and the energy surges back, raising Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed together. If the user is put to sleep or frozen while gathering, or the channel window is cleared early, the energy collapses and nothing is gained.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.use.0: Gather at a safe distance before a fight
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.use.1: Trade a standing channel for three permanent boosts
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.use.2: Leave a ground rune underfoot to mark the battlefield
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.0: The second beat raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed by %1$s each.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.1: The first beat channels for %1$s; it can only be used while standing on the ground, and the user stands rooted and cannot act during this time.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.2: After the burst the rune's afterglow lingers on the ground, then fades on its own.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.description.3: %1$s wind-up, %2$s recovery, %3$s cooldown. Sleep or freeze during the channel, or clearing the channel window early, collapses the energy and gains nothing.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.geomancy.preference.ai: Geomancy is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means starting earlier at longer range.
A threat closer than this makes the companion give up the channel and fight; the user cannot move while gathering, so larger is more cautious.
